title: TomSpecs Document (*.docspecs.yaml)
description: Structural schema for the generic on-disk TomSpecs document wire format written by SpecDocumentYaml.encode (format version 1). Validates the file envelope and pass value-types, independently of any per-root DocSpecs schema.

version.description: On-disk format version (independent of the model stamp).

modelVersion.description: Authoring object-model version (major.minor) the content was last written against.

review.description: Optional editor structural-review pass; opaque to the runtime, so its inner shape is unconstrained.

document.description: The live object-model values, keyed by full section path. Any missing pass decodes as empty.

contentMap.description: Content/scalar leaves: section path -> text value.

formsMap.description: @Form sections: section path -> (field name -> text value).

listsMap.description: Lists: list path -> ordered item entry.

listEntry.description: A list pass entry: a monotonic sequence counter and the ordered item paths.

seq.description: Per-list monotonic counter; never reused (item paths are <listPath>-<seq>).

items.description: Ordered item paths in the list.
